description_en: Queries the alert banner information of a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-alarm-banner --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-kf740000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAlarmBanner

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

BannerStatus.description_en: The status information of the alert banner

Cause.description_en:
The cause of the alert. If Type is set to sandbox, valid values:

fivefold: The queries per second (QPS) of your service exceeds five times the upper limit of your plan.

4count: The QPS of your service has exceeded the upper limit of your plan for four or more days.

exceed10w: The peak QPS of your service exceeds 100,000.

costProtection: Billing protection is triggered
Cause.description_zh:
告警原因。当告警类型为沙箱（Type取值为sandbox）时，取值为：

fivefold: 表示业务的QPS已超过当前规格。
4count：表示实际业务请求数QPS已累计超过当前规格。
exceed10w: 表示实际业务请求峰值QPS已超过10万。
costProtection: 表示触发计费保护

Count.description_en:
The count associated with the alert at the time it was triggered.

If Type is set to sandbox, this parameter indicates the number of days that the QPS has exceeded the upper limit of your plan
Count.description_zh:
告警时使用量。

当告警类型为沙箱（Type取值为sandbox）时，表示超用的天数

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether an alert is triggered. Valid values:

true: An alert is triggered. If Type is set to sandbox, the instance is in the sandbox.

false: No alert is triggered. If Type is set to sandbox, the instance is not in the sandbox
Status.description_zh:
告警状态。取值为：
true：表示告警中。当告警类型为沙箱（Type取值为sandbox）时，表示在沙箱中。
false：表示未告警。当告警类型为沙箱（Type取值为sandbox）时，表示未在沙箱中

Type.description_en:
The alert type. Valid value:

sandbox: a sandbox alert
Type.description_zh:
告警类型。取值：

sandbox：表示沙箱告警
